description:
Winter Solstice: Why Winter Nights Are the Longest of the Ye — Welcome to the Winter Solstice! Today is the shortest day and longest night of the entire year! Why does that happen?
Kids science answer for "winter solstice for kids cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Earth spins at a 23.5-degree tilt. During December, the Northern Hemisphere tilts furthest away from the sun, making the sun's path across the sky short and low, giving us the longest night of the year.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
